description: Rules the multi-page check (tests/runtime/check-templates-multipage.py) applies to every Writer template and to the wizard output of the same type, when the body runs to each page count. Margins are where the body may start and end; the page number sits in the top margin from page 2, never on the first page of a document or of an attached document. Sources: Decree 30/2020 Annex I, Part I, I.1-I.7 and III.4 (state); Decree 78/2025 as amended by Decree 187/2025 Annex I (qppl); Guide 05-HD/VPTW of 27/5/2026, Part II.IV.4-5 and Annex 2 (dang; it replaces Guide 36-HD/VPTW of 2018, same values).
